hero.lead: I'm Sayantan Chakraborty. For 11+ years I've run Oracle RAC, Data Guard, GoldenGate and EBS estates for enterprise, government and healthcare teams, with 24x7 operations and tested disaster recovery.
hero.availability_text: Open to DBA / DRE roles and consulting engagements

metrics.label: Oracle, RAC, Data Guard and EBS in production

about.label: About
about.stamp_text: Observable systems, rehearsed recovery and calm incident response.
about.heading: Deep Oracle expertise, with the whole platform in mind.
paragraphs: Most recently I led cloud infrastructure services for Equifax production at UST, keeping GoldenGate replication within sub-second SLAs. Before that I ran Oracle and PostgreSQL platforms at IIT Delhi and Ndedge Informatics, and spent years implementing Oracle EBS for public-sector and manufacturing clients.

experience.label: Experience
experience.heading: Built through real production challenges.
experience.intro: From Oracle EBS rollouts in 2010 to leading 24x7 database reliability for a global credit bureau.

roles.title: Lead II, Cloud Infrastructure Services
points: Directed Equifax production infrastructure across databases, servers and VMs.
Resolved critical incidents across Oracle 11g/12c/19c, GoldenGate XAG and OEM 13c with sub-second replication SLAs.
Mentored junior DBAs and coordinated vulnerability management with zero unplanned downtime.

roles.title: Senior Subject-Matter Expert
points: Migrated production servers from Oracle Linux 7.9 to 8.2 hosting Oracle 19c.
Quarterly CPU/PSU patching across HA environments with zero unplanned downtime.

roles.title: Senior Project Scientist
points: Containerised Linux infrastructure for 10+ research projects with 99.9% uptime.
PostgreSQL 15/16 with etcd and Patroni; automated database builds in under 30 minutes.

roles.title: Principal Consultant, Infrastructure Systems
points: Owned 15+ critical healthcare and manufacturing systems; led a team of 4 DBAs.
Migrations with 35% efficiency gains; Terraform IaC on GCP and AWS.

items.q: What does Sayantan Chakraborty specialise in?
items.a: Oracle database administration and database reliability engineering: Oracle RAC, Data Guard, GoldenGate, RMAN, Oracle EBS, performance tuning and disaster recovery, plus automation with Ansible and Terraform.

items.q: How many years of experience does he have?
items.a: More than 11 years running production Oracle databases for enterprise, government and healthcare organisations, including estates of 125 TB, 456 databases and 180 servers.
Bangalore, India. He works with teams remotely as well.

items.q: How can I get his resume?
items.a: Use "Verify email to get resume" on this site. A one-time code is emailed to you, and the PDF downloads once the code is verified.

items.a: On YouTube at @csayantan, where he publishes Oracle DBA and database reliability walkthroughs.
